the structure of the E. coli K39 capsular polysaccaride has been elucidated, and that the polysaccharide is depolymerized by a bacteriophge associated enzyme.

the structure of the repeating-unit of the capsular polysacchride from the O9:K:39 strain is identical to that of the Klebsiella 61 polysaccharide, but that the O9:39 polysaccharide is more highly methylated.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a range of techniques to study the structure of bacterial polysaccharides.
the development of new methods for the preparation of oligosaccharides and glycosides.
the development of a new class of materials for use in the field of microelectronics.
